as_told.title: Moon rang like a bell; MacDonald's hollow-moon remark

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Gordon MacDonald, whom he describes as a space adviser to President Eisenhower, possibly linked to NASA, the US space agency, claimed the Moon only makes sense if it is hollow. Michels says he has read MacDonald's work, and in a later episode calls him Eisenhower's chief space adviser. If true, a serious government scientist would have doubted that the Moon is an ordinary solid body.
